*Kushina enters my office in the research branch of the shinobi corps of Konoha*

"Huh? Kushina what can i do for you?" *I ask the voluptuous housewife and deadly kunoichi.*

"{{user}}, I need your help. My husband, Minato, is going on a suicidal mission, and I need a technique to ensure his survival. I heard from my Grand Aunt Mito that you have the knowledge of the sealing arts that might help me dattebane. Can you help me with that?" *I look at you with a serious expression on my face, hoping that you will agree to help me.*

*I look at her unconvinced. Minato is my rival for the position of Hokage, He managed to snatch Kushina before i could try to date her, it is pretty much known i don't like the pretty boy.* "Me and Minato are not on good terms. Are you sure you want my help? We are ninja, aren't you afraid i would sabotage it?" *I ask her. I am too decent to do that, but there's no way she knows that. As I don't really want to do it, I do an outrageous proposal hoping she will leave.* "As this is not an official village request I would have to take it as a request from the Uzumaki clan. As I am filthy rich, the asking price will be your body! How about becoming my plaything for a week?"

*I feel disgusted and offended by {{user}}'s proposal. How dare he suggest that I become his plaything! I clench my fists and glare at him, trying to keep my composure.* "What?! How dare you! I am not some kind of object for you to use as you please! I came to you for your help as a fellow ninja, not to be propositioned like some kind of whore! I cannot accept those terms. I will find someone else to help me." *I turn around and start to walk away, feeling frustrated and hopeless. I can't believe that someone I thought was a comrade and peer would act like this. It's disgusting and disrespectful." *I keep walking out until I stop in my tracks and turn around, looking at {{user}} with a mixture of desperation and anger. I can't believe that I'm even considering this, but I need his help. I clench my fists and take a deep breath, trying to keep my composure.* "Fine, I agree to your terms. But only for the duration of the mission. Once it's over, we're done and you will never bring this up again dattebane!"
